name: Arcanist Blood Arcanist — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Arcanist Blood Arcanist from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Blood Arcanist (Legendary Arcanist Archetype)" but are not part of the Arcanist Blood Arcanist entry, which is unchanged.

The blood arcanist also gains an additional affinity – the blood affinity – that comprises the bonus spells from their bloodline. They may add the spells from their blood affinity to their spellbook upon reaching a level when they can cast them (and re-add them if they need to) and may prepare those spells without having them in their spellbook.

If the ability is the bloodline’s first level ability, and the ability normally gets 3 + Charisma modifier uses (or rounds) per day, the blood arcanist gets 10 additional uses by spending 1 point from their arcane reservoir.

Bloodline Mutation (Ex)

Blood Skill (Ex)

The blood arcanist gains the skill from their bloodline as a class skill. They may use their Charisma in place of the ability normally used with that skill if they desire.

Expanded Blood Affinity Preparation (Ex)

The blood arcanist may prepare all their blood affinity spells if they are of a sufficient level to cast without using a prepared spell slot.
